summary: One behavior: the versioned save system persists and restores endgame milestone state (schema extension with trivial migration plus pre-descent and post-trigger autosave points). Two changed subsystems (save system, headless scenario tests), within the three-responsibility limit. Criterion AC-end-variants is inherited verbatim from parent WI-05c and shared with sibling WI-05ca (final proof owner); this child proves migration correctness and save-reload at each milestone. Deliverables are checkable and focused on persistence only, with explicit non-goals excluding ending-variant branching. Tests cover migration, both autosave points, restart, and determinism. The handoff names exact files, sections, and gating points so a fresh implementer can proceed without reconstructing project context. Dependencies (WI-05b) are correct and no ancestor/descendant cycles exist.
